patterns.title: SAP MDG change exists, but no current outbound event is proven
patterns.symptom: MDG contains the newer customer value, S/4 still shows the older value, and an older successful message exists.
search_phrases: SAP MDG customer not replicated to S/4
SAP IDoc green but latest change missing
patterns.signal_establishes: An older technical success can be present while the current authoritative change still has no causally linked outbound event in the supplied evidence.
patterns.not_established: The older successful message does not prove that the latest business change was replicated.

patterns.title: SAP transport succeeded, but business processing rejected the change
patterns.symptom: The integration layer shows technical success, yet the target processing layer rejected the business change.
search_phrases: SAP IDoc successful but business error
SAP AIF message successful target rejected
patterns.signal_establishes: Transport reached the target processing layer and the supplied business acknowledgement rejected the current change.
patterns.not_established: Technical delivery success does not prove business acceptance or a correct target state.

patterns.title: SAP mapping changed: replaying an old message can be unsafe
patterns.symptom: A current identity or mapping version differs from the version under which the historical event was created.
search_phrases: SAP CPI mapping changed reprocess old message
patterns.signal_establishes: The current mapping and the event-time mapping differ in the supplied evidence.
patterns.not_established: The current mapping cannot safely be assumed to describe the historical event or its original target identity.

patterns.title: SAP message was accepted, but the target business value is still wrong
patterns.symptom: The current message is causally linked and accepted, but the latest target observation still differs from the authoritative source value.
search_phrases: SAP IDoc successful but data not updated
patterns.signal_establishes: The supplied evidence reaches the target processing layer but the expected business postcondition is not satisfied.
patterns.not_established: A successful message status alone does not establish that the business object is correct in the target.

patterns.title: When is it safe to retry a failed SAP integration message?
patterns.symptom: The message linked to the current business change has a technical failure status.
patterns.signal_establishes: The current causally linked message failed technically in the supplied evidence.
patterns.not_established: A technical failure does not reveal whether a partial commit occurred or whether replay is idempotent.

patterns.title: SAP Customer to Business Partner identity is unresolved — do not correct the target yet
patterns.symptom: The source customer cannot be mapped to one resolved target Business Partner with the supplied identity evidence.
search_phrases: SAP BP replication wrong business partner
patterns.signal_establishes: Cross-system identity is unresolved or ambiguous in the supplied evidence.
patterns.not_established: Similarity, naming, or a convenient target record does not prove canonical business identity.

patterns.title: A stale S/4 snapshot cannot prove the latest SAP replication succeeded
patterns.symptom: The target-state observation predates the current outbound event.
search_phrases: SAP target state older than IDoc
patterns.signal_establishes: The available target observation is older than the current message and therefore cannot verify its business outcome.
patterns.not_established: An old target snapshot cannot prove either success or failure of the newer event.

patterns.title: SAP replication event points to the wrong target Business Partner
patterns.symptom: The current message targets a different target identity from the resolved source-to-target mapping.
search_phrases: SAP business partner replication wrong target
patterns.signal_establishes: The message target conflicts with the currently resolved business identity in the supplied evidence.
patterns.not_established: The message must not be replayed merely because it is current; event-time identity must be resolved first.
